artifacts.description: Language for specs, plans, AI docs and commit messages.

responses.description: Language the agent uses when talking to the user.

documents.description: Language for human-facing documents such as the Definition of Done.

domains.description: Octo domain skill catalogs to install (discovered on demand). The 'core' domain is always installed.

exclude.description: Superpowers skills not to install in this repo.

models.description: Per host: the models the company allows, and which of them each tier uses. Tiers may only reference allowed models.

maxSubagents.description: Upper bound of subagents dispatched at once.

level.description: Preset this block came from (octo autonomy supervised|balanced|full). Informational.

spec.description: Wait for the user's approval of the spec (brainstorming).

plan.description: Wait for the user's review of the plan before executing.

commit.description: Commit automatically after verification, on a feature branch.

push.description: Push the feature branch without asking. Force push stays denied.

pullRequest.description: Open the pull request without asking (GitHub via gh, Azure DevOps via az), detected from origin.

branchPattern.description: Work branch names. {type} = feature | fix | docs | chore, {topic} = short kebab-case topic. Default: {type}/{topic}-octo

askWhen.description: Situations in which the agent must stop and ask the user.

dod.description: Definition of Done documents (one per spec/plan, a screenshot per web scenario).

extraCriteria.description: Repo-specific criteria added to the DoD checklist.

nativeInstructions.description: awesome-copilot instructions (file names, e.g. apex.instructions.md) to also install in .github/instructions/ for Copilot. They apply automatically by glob, so mind their size.

commit.description: true: session files travel with the feature branch; false: local only (git-ignored).

guardrails.description: Claude Code: enforced as permissions. Copilot: commands require confirmation; the rest is instructions.

deny.description: Command prefixes the agent must never run.

ask.description: Command prefixes that need the user's confirmation.

allow.description: Command prefixes that run without confirmation.

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns the agent must not read or edit.

maxFixRounds.description: Fix-loop rounds per task before stopping to ask.

enable.description: MCP servers from the framework's mcp/ registry to install.

servers.description: Repo-specific MCP servers. Use {env:NAME} for secrets and {workspace} for the repo root.

usage.description: When the agent should use it.

promoted.description: Catalog skills to install as native skills.
